description: Emitted when a mark is submitted with its annotation body

source.description: The '@id' of the resource the mark belongs to (W3C target.source). Routes the submit to the state unit bound to that resource — without it, N mounted units each create the annotation (N copies on N resources).

body.description: Optional body. Omit for annotations whose motivation alone is meaningful (e.g. highlighting) or whose user-supplied content is empty (e.g. an assessing annotation saved without comment text). Shape matches Annotation.body.
